The Craft

Wood marquetry is painting with wood itself — the picture is built from the wood, never applied on top of it.

Every colour you see in a Woodarticraft piece is a different natural wood — the pale gold of the background, the deep walnut of a girl's hair, the russet of her dress. Nothing is painted and nothing is printed.

Each shape is cut by hand and fitted against its neighbours, piece by piece, until the grains meet like a puzzle with no gaps. A turned bowl begins the same way: shaped on the lathe, then pierced by hand so light can pass through the rim.

The rosette in the Woodarticraft mark comes from the stone flowers of Persepolis — a reminder that in this craft, a flower can outlast the garden by two thousand years when it is made well.

  • Natural wood onlyColour comes from the species and the grain — walnut, and other natural woods, each chosen for its tone.
  • No paint, everIf a colour is in the picture, it grew in a tree. That rule is the whole point of the work.
  • Piece by piece, by handCut, fitted and finished by hand in the workshop — slow work, on purpose.
  • One of a kindWood grain never repeats, so neither does a piece. Yours will be the only one.

Commissions

Every Woodarticraft piece is made to order in the workshop. If a panel or a bowl in the gallery caught your eye — or you have an idea of your own — here is how it works.

  1. 1 Say hello on InstagramTap the button below — it opens a direct message to @woodarticraft.
  2. 2 Share your ideaA character, a scene, a bowl for your table — describe it, or point to a piece you liked. You will talk through woods, size and price together.
  3. 3 Made by hand, for youYour piece is cut, fitted and finished by hand — natural wood only, no paint — and it will be the only one of its kind.
